To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the maintenance problem can be reduced to a manageable size by transforming the maintenance links into an equivalent set, that knowledge items can be used to represent knowledge, and that knowledge items can protect knowledge from unforeseen modifications.
the maintenance problem is reduced by transforming the set of maintenance links into an equivalent set and that the maintenance links are used to specify knowledge integrity constraints.

knowledge base maintenance is best managed by constructing an abstract formal model, that the formal model is best constructed by using knowledge items, that knowledge items are best represented by declarative rules, that each declarative rule is best implemented by a set of imperative procedures, and that maintenance links between knowledge items can be used to analyze the maintenance requirements.

knowledge base maintenance.
the analysis and simplification of knowledge base maintenance problems.
the development of a formal model of knowledge base maintenance and the analysis of the formal model.

we have developed a model of knowledge base maintenance and a method for simplifying the model.

we have provided a formal basis for knowledge maintenance.

knowledge base maintenance is a problem that can be managed by formalizing it.
